lines.lyric_translation: You, just like that, as if nothing’s wrong

lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 웃고 있는데 들리는 네 말에
lines.lyric_translation: You’re smiling, but I can hear it in your words

lines.lyric: You always say “I’m okay” hajiman da boyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: You always say "I'm okay" 하지만 다 보여
lines.lyric_translation: You always say “I’m okay” but I can see it all
Inside your heart, you’re sobbing alone
After turning off the lights in that quiet room,

lines.lyric: Hwanhage utgo itteon neon jeomjeom shideureoga
lines.lyric_hangul: 환하게 웃고 있던 넌 점점 시들어가
lines.lyric_translation: You, who were smiling so brightly, begin to wilt
In an empty space with no one else
A night with nothing but the occasional long sigh
Inside your heart, you’re sobbing alone
Eyes turned barren by reality, ey

lines.lyric: Ne maeumsoge oashiseu ttawineun boiji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 네 마음속의 오아시스 따위는 보이지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t see anything like an oasis in your heart
You’re forever wandering

lines.lyric: Naega han bal gakkai dagaga ooh
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 한 발 가까이 다가가 ooh
lines.lyric_translation: I take one step closer, ooh

lines.lyric: Maleopshi wechineun neoye moksorireul naega deureo julge
lines.lyric_hangul: 말없이 외치는 너의 목소리를 내가 들어줄게
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll be the one to listen to your voice’s silent cry

lines.lyric_hangul: 맘속 한켠에서 길을 잃어 더는 지치지 않게
lines.lyric_translation: So that you don’t get tired anymore / While lost in some corner of your heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 서툴게 닫아 둔 너라는 그 공간 문틈 사이로
lines.lyric_translation: Slipping through a crack in the door / Of the clumsily closed-off space called “you”

parts.lyric: Seotulge dada dun neoraneun geu gonggan

lines.lyric_translation: A silent cry that only I can hear
A silent cry that you’ve been hiding all this time

lines.lyric: Joyonghi gamchweodun neoye nunmureul ijen boyeodo dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 조용히 감춰둔 너의 눈물을 이젠 보여도 돼
lines.lyric_translation: Now you can show the tears you’ve been quietly hiding
To me, woah woah woah
Will you let me hear / The things you got used to saying to yourself?
Don’t be the only one hurting

lines.lyric: Naege jweo ne Silent Cry woah
lines.lyric_hangul: 내게 줘 네 silent cry woah
lines.lyric_translation: Give me your silent cry, woah
I’ll cry with you

lines.lyric: Geuman chamgo Let it go go go
lines.lyric_hangul: 그만 참고 let it go go go
lines.lyric_translation: Stop holding it in, let it go go go
If you lose your strength, I’ll hold you

lines.lyric: Gidaegiman hae Cause I won’t let you go
lines.lyric_hangul: 기대기만 해 cause I won't let you go
lines.lyric_translation: Just lean on me, cause I won’t let you go

lines.lyric: Chamgiman haneun geotto shwipji aneun geot gatae
lines.lyric_hangul: 참기만 하는 것도 쉽지 않은 것 같아
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t think it’s easy to keep holding it in either

lines.lyric: Honjaseo noryeokhaedo an dwel ttaedo maneunde
lines.lyric_hangul: 혼자서 노력해도 안 될 때도 많은데
lines.lyric_translation: There are many times when trying on your own isn’t enough

lines.lyric: Neon utgo shipji aneundedo utgo isseo wae
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 웃고 싶지 않은데도 웃고 있어 왜
lines.lyric_translation: Why are you smiling even though you don’t want to?
I’ll say the words “it’s okay” for you instead

lines.lyric: Maleopshi wechineun neoye moksorireul naega deureo julge
lines.lyric_hangul: 말없이 외치는 너의 목소리를 내가 들어줄게

lines.lyric_translation: Slipping through a crack in the door / Of the clumsily closed-off space called “you”
A silent cry that only I can hear
A silent cry that you’ve been hiding all this time

lines.lyric_hangul: 조용히 감춰둔 너의 눈물을 이젠 보여도 돼
lines.lyric_translation: Now you can show the tears you’ve been quietly hiding
To me, woah woah woah
Will you let me hear / The things you got used to saying to yourself?
Don’t be the only one hurting (don’t be hurting)
When it rains inside your heart
I’ll get rained on with you

lines.lyric: Beotigoman itji ma naega usaneul pyeolge
lines.lyric_hangul: 버티고만 있지 마 내가 우산을 펼게
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t just endure it, I’ll open up an umbrella
Trying to stop your overflowing tears / Looks overwhelming

lines.lyric_hangul: 빗물이 고여 빗물이 고여 모든 일이 꼬여
lines.lyric_translation: The rainwater wells up, the rainwater wells up, / Everything gets complicated
The dark shadow behind a bright you
You can let me uncover you, don’t hide
Silent Cry
Silent Cry
A silent cry that only I can hear
A silent cry that you’ve been hiding all this time
